newsitem.title: UK: IBCA upgrade Ergobank's legal rating to 2 from 4.
newsitem.headline: IBCA upgrade Ergobank's legal rating to 2 from 4.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Tuesday it upgraded Ergobank's legal rating to 2 from 4 and affirmed its individual rating of B.
"Ergobank is the second largest private sector bank in Greece and the fifth largest commercial bank with a market share of over five percent of deposits," IBCA said in a statement.
It remains one of Europe's most profitable banks, has sound asset quality, strong liquidity and is comfortably capitalised, the rating agency said.

The bank has grown strongly in recent years, and its position as one of the leading Greek banks means that, in IBCA's opinion, support would be forthcoming from the Greek authorities should it be required.
